title: Part 4: Home again
summary_es: Peter escapa por debajo de la puerta y llega a casa agotado. Esa noche no se siente bien y su madre le da té de manzanilla.

blocks.text: Peter got down very quietly off the wheelbarrow; and started running as fast as he could go, along a straight walk behind some black-currant bushes.
Mr. McGregor caught sight of him at the corner, but Peter did not care. He slipped underneath the gate, and was safe at last in the wood outside the garden.
Mr. McGregor hung up the little jacket and the shoes for a scare-crow to frighten the blackbirds.
Peter never stopped running or looked behind him till he got home to the big fir-tree.

He was so tired that he flopped down upon the nice soft sand on the floor of the rabbit-hole and shut his eyes. His mother was busy cooking; she wondered what he had done with his clothes. It was the second little jacket and pair of shoes that Peter had lost in a fortnight!
I am sorry to say that Peter was not very well during the evening.
His mother put him to bed, and made some camomile tea; and she gave a dose of it to Peter!
'One table-spoonful to be taken at bed-time.'
But Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail had bread and milk and blackberries for supper.

options: Se desliza por debajo de la puerta
Salta el muro desde la carretilla
Pasa por un agujero junto al estanque
Sale por la puerta que quedó abierta
questions.answer: Se desliza por debajo de la puerta
questions.why: Dice: He slipped underneath the gate.

questions.q: ¿Qué hace el señor McGregor con la chaqueta y los zapatos?
options: Un espantapájaros para asustar a los mirlos
Un espantapájaros para asustar a los conejos
Los guarda para dárselos a su hijo
Los cuelga en el cobertizo para secarlos
questions.answer: Un espantapájaros para asustar a los mirlos
questions.why: Dice: for a scare-crow to frighten the blackbirds.

questions.q: Era la primera vez que Peter perdía su ropa.
questions.why: Era la segunda chaqueta y el segundo par de zapatos en quince días.

questions.q: ¿Qué le da su madre a Peter?

questions.q: ¿Cuál es la moraleja implícita del cuento?
questions.why: Peter desobedece y termina asustado, sin ropa y enfermo, mientras sus hermanas disfrutan la cena.
